item.title: The Lost Treasure of Sid Meier's Pirates
item.description:
📝 Pirates was something different. Those have controls and mechanics that are totally unlike any other game combat I've seen. The game models the way that a pirate's harsh life wears you down over time, each merchant ship captain or colonial guard that you fight seeming that little bit faster until you have to admit that your sword arm just isn't what it used to be.
🔗 Read more: https://remapradio.com/articles/the-lost-treasure-of-sid-meiers-pirates/

item.title: We Rebuilt the Linux MicroVM Stack on Apple Silicon
item.description:
📝 Images were the hard half, because Firecracker boots a block device and Docker produces layers. Firecracker expects those tap devices to attach to a host bridge, and inside a Docker container there is no host bridge. The tap devices then had something to attach to that looked enough like a real Docker host.
🔗 Read more: https://encore.dev/blog/firecracker-apple-silicon
